dataset_info.summary: Recordings of real business meetings, captured on each speaker's own headset microphone. One row is one segment of meeting speech with its transcript, and a fighter has to transcribe it. The speech is spontaneous, overlapping and full of interruptions and false starts, none of which a read-speech corpus contains. The whole registered split is scored, uncapped.
dataset_info.notes: AMI Meeting Corpus, IHM (individual headset mic) test split, en-GB business-meeting speech. The far-field SDM config exists in the same repo (edinburghcstr/ami, subset 'sdm') and is a natural follow-up once single-mic results establish a baseline.
